prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one opaque 2-by-2 square atlas of four top-down terrain tiles for a faithful HD remaster. Generate a NEW hand-painted atlas using ONLY the two Original sprite references. Image1 is the authentic native64 four-tile atlas. Image2 is the SAME Original enlarged by exact nearest-neighbor to1024, making its positions readable. Their grayscale shapes are the Source of truth. No previous HD image is a reference.
Exact order: top-left304b1, top-right304b2, bottom-left304b3, bottom-right304b5. Every quadrant is one full32x32 Original canvas edge-to-edge. Equal quadrants, no gutter/margin/text. Desired2048 square. Strict overhead orthographic viewpoint. Do not combine these four independent tiles into one scene.
Primary visual request: translate the Original's SAME broad gray value shapes into restrained, shallow, continuous hand-painted HD terrain. Favor flat matte gray surfaces with quiet fine-scale authored wear. Keep the Source's large neutral-gray and charcoal regions, dark negative spaces and slight tonal irregularity. The Original is mostly low-relief map artwork: edges can be crisp, but must not acquire bright bevel bands, stacked masonry, deep extrusion or hard cast shadows. Fine detail remains subordinate to the original shapes at small game size. Paint real continuous new microdetail, without pixel-square blocks, coarse speckle, grunge clutter or procedural-looking pebble repetition.
304b1, upper-left: follow the exact irregular dark cavity outline, dim broken surrounding patches, bottom gray panel/ledge and short low-left slot. Recess is dark and largely quiet. Preserve existing small Source rim/remnant pieces at their positions; interpret their shading modestly, without adding stepped rim layers or large contrasting facing slabs. Keep the tiny warm ordinary patch near logical22,7 subtle and in place.
304b2, upper-right: the broad gray right field remains calm and largely empty; preserve the Source's upper-left dark cutback, pale left strip, short bottom-left support/ledge, dark underside and sparse existing lower remnants. These remnants do exist in Source: preserve their number and normalized positions, with shallow relief, and do not enlarge or brighten them into a new frame.
304b3, lower-left: preserve the broad charcoal left field, thin far-left strip, the right-side narrow vertical rail group and its crossings, and low ledge from the right. Crossings already occur near logical rows8 and16; the dark interval near22..26 and lower ledge near27..30 should keep their source positions. Do not move major rails or invent a raised left slab. Keep dark surface texture quiet, not shiny/granular.
304b5, lower-right: preserve the gray left field and dark inset at right with the Source's sparse internal bands/remnants at their exact positions and widths. Existing lighter bands near logical rows6,8,15,20 and lower sill26..28 are real Source features; keep them without turning each into a bright thick concrete beam or regularizing the gaps into a perfect new grille. Keep the dark interior simple and deep gray/black.
Original imagery controls whenever prose is approximate. Preserve normalized Source geometry and edge crossings in all quadrants. No new cracks, bolts, rubble, frames, bars, objects, rust, colored glow, symbols, labels, text, borders, padding, perspective or spotlights. Whole atlas opaque and full bleed. Render four clean, understated HD counterparts whose silhouette and large-scale shading remain the Original at a glance.
